title: Famous models were trained on too little text
body: DeepMind's Chinchilla study (2022) found compute-optimal training balances parameters and tokens, about twenty tokens per parameter, implying celebrated models like GPT-3 were oversized for their data. A smaller Chinchilla trained longer beat the much larger Gopher. The field had been buying parameters when it should have been buying textbooks.
source_hint: Hoffmann et al., 'Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models' (2022)
